This is the actual monodromy trace at every complex potential, not just the free potential.

ClassicalHillTraceGradientJets proves the actual third-order squared-eigenfunction equation Gthird=2*qprime*G+4*(q-mu)*Gprime. ClassicalHillTraceGradientBoundary proves all required periodic endpoint identities from the actual normalized monodromy determinant. Only the stated interior derivative and potential endpoint closure are needed.

ThirdOrderPeriodicLagrange proves the periodic third-order Green identity (mu-nu)*integral(f*gprime)=0 with continuous jets and prescribed interior derivatives. The equal-energy actual-gradient case is separately proved by the derivative of G^2. ClassicalHillTraceGradientCommutation therefore proves integral G_mu*Gprime_nu=0 for every energy pair and every differentiable periodic complex potential.

Every complex energy pair is covered, including equal energies. No finite-GAP density or abstract involution premise is used.
